answer: In each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake and obtains a Semaphore membership witness, while an RLN rate-limit circuit binds its authenticated messages to a polynomial identity commitment. The agent evaluates the epoch polynomial; duplicate messages expose two shares of the same Shamir secret, reconstructing the private key and triggering immediate, verifiable collateral slashing. Thus canyon, nectar, and grove identities cannot multiply influence without risking stake.
